question: Who is Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Science and Technology as of July 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jitendra Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jitendra Singh is the Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Science and Technology as of July 2023.
 
• He has been serving in this position since his appointment by the Prime Minister.
 
• Jitendra Singh is also known for his roles in various other ministries, including the Ministry of Earth Sciences and the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances, and Pensions.
 
• He has been actively involved in promoting scientific research and development in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Union Minister of State (Independent Charge)**

 
 
• In the Indian government, a Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) is a minister who is in charge of a ministry without an overseeing cabinet minister.
 
• These ministers have the same responsibilities as cabinet ministers in their respective ministries but report directly to the Prime Minister.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Science and Technology**
 
 
• This ministry is responsible for the promotion of science and technology in India.
 
• It encompasses several departments, including the Department of Science and Technology (DST), the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), and the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).
 
• The ministry aims to boost scientific research, innovation, and development in various fields such as space, biotechnology, and renewable energy.
 
 
 
• **Jitendra Singh**
 
 
• Jitendra Singh is an Indian politician and a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He has held various significant positions in the government, contributing to policies and initiatives in multiple sectors.
 
• He is known for his work in improving governance and administration, as well as fostering scientific advancements in the country.
